title: Ayline's Crispy Rice Paper Chicken
ingredients: Chicken: 300g boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
Seasoning: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp garlic powder, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp black pepper
Wrapper: 6 sheets rice paper, cut into small squares
Hydration: 150ml warm water in a shallow bowl
Cooking: 1 tbsp vegetable oil or cooking spray for air frying
steps: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and mix with soy sauce, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Dip rice paper squares briefly into warm water until pliable, then wrap each piece of seasoned chicken tightly.
Dip each wrapped chicken bite into the beaten egg to ensure the rice paper coating stays securely sealed.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C and lightly grease the basket with vegetable oil or cooking spray.
Place the chicken bites in the basket, spray lightly with oil, and air fry at 200°C for 12 minutes until crispy.
